cases.basis: The referent is the transition from one state to another.
cases.text: The change from liquid to solid took less than a minute.

cases.basis: The indefinite nominal refers to a distinct occurrence that caused a delay.
cases.text: An incident delayed the train by twenty minutes.

cases.basis: The complement specifies an unplanned occurrence and no injury or damage.
cases.text: It was an accident that the two trains arrived at the same minute.

cases.basis: The clause gives the start and duration of the burning event.
cases.text: The fire started after midnight and burned all night.

cases.basis: The sentence identifies the rising event, as distinct from its time or atmospheric effects.
cases.text: The sunrise came before six, when the sun rose above the horizon.

cases.basis: The roof physically falls. This is the natural-event sense.
cases.text: Snow caused the collapse of the roof when the center beam fell.

cases.basis: The contest concludes through the event of crossing the line.
cases.text: The finish of the race came when two runners crossed the line together.

cases.basis: The repair is what the mechanic did to return the motor to working order.
cases.text: The mechanic carried out the repair and put the motor in working order.

cases.basis: The kick is the player's act of delivering a blow with her foot.
cases.text: The player delivered a kick with her left foot.

cases.basis: The nominal describes the application of force by the guard.
cases.text: With a push, the guard applied enough force to move the gate.

cases.basis: The nominal picks out the act of dividing something into parts.
cases.text: With one cut, she divided the rope into two parts.

cases.basis: The injection is the act of putting liquid into the body by syringe.
cases.text: The nurse gave the injection with a syringe.

cases.basis: The duration belongs to the act of making something clean.
cases.text: The cleaning took an hour because she scrubbed every shelf.

cases.basis: This is the police action of taking someone into custody.
cases.text: The arrest took place when the police apprehended the fugitive.

cases.basis: The target is her activity of buying, with the time adjunct locating the activity.
cases.text: The buying took all morning as she purchased supplies for the shop.

cases.basis: The sense denotes the person. Her arriving describes which person; this gloss does not warrant projecting the action or event from that relative.
cases.text: The late arrival was a woman carrying a green suitcase.

cases.basis: The referent is the projectile that lodged in the door, distinct from the firing event.
cases.text: The shot lodged in the oak door, and the carpenter dug it out.

cases.basis: The product sense is distinct from the effort that produced the sculpture.
cases.text: The work was a marble sculpture that stood in the courtyard.

cases.basis: The injury is the result of cutting, and it is the wound that needs stitches.
cases.text: The cut in her skin needed three stitches.

cases.basis: The referent is an inactive state after interruption.
cases.text: The heartbeat remained in arrest until the pump restarted it.

cases.basis: The sentence leaves a pause, fracture, lucky break, and other readings open.
cases.text: She told me about the break.

cases.basis: A photograph, projectile, injection, and other readings are compatible.
cases.text: He was surprised by the shot.

cases.basis: A race, trip, operating interval, and other readings remain possible.
cases.text: She told me about the run.

cases.basis: The auxiliary marks possibility in the registered modal construction.
cases.text: The guests might leave early.
